ratings.concern: Use can change over time, but that does not undermine the stated subclass.
ratings.rationale: The child is defined as a train with a passenger-conveyance function, so it is a straightforward functional subtype of train.

ratings.concern: Parent is cited by IRI only; the score assumes the standard BFO process reading.
ratings.rationale: A rail journey is defined as an occurrence of conveyance between stations, matching BFO_0000015 (process).

ratings.concern: A more specific plan-specification parent may be preferable, but the broad ICE parent remains coherent.
ratings.rationale: A journey plan is defined as content specifying an intended journey and schedule, so it fits IAO_0000030 (information content entity).

ratings.concern: None material if the parent IRI is the standard BFO role class.
ratings.rationale: The child is explicitly defined as a role realized in being conveyed, matching BFO_0000023 (role).

ratings.concern: Likely BFO category error if passenger denotes an agent rather than a passenger role.
ratings.rationale: The child is a role inhering in a person, whereas the parent is labeled passenger under an agent ontology and is not shown to be a role.

ratings.concern: Parent IRI ends in reservation while the label says reservation information; score follows the supplied label.
ratings.rationale: Rail reservation information is defined as reservation information restricted to rail-travel allocation, so the subclass is definitional.

ratings.concern: Bearer versus digital information is an unresolved category choice and blocks treating this subclass as settled.
ratings.rationale: Calling a rail ticket a ticket is lexically natural, but the child is fixed as a material information bearer.

ratings.concern: A station could alternatively be modeled as a site; this axiom is sound only under the material-facility reading.
ratings.rationale: The definition commits the station to physical facilities, which are material entities under BFO_0000040.

ratings.concern: None material; object aggregate remains within material entity.
ratings.rationale: A train composed of rail vehicles is a material object or object aggregate, hence a material entity under BFO_0000040.
